cues: An essay that argues needs a thesis: one sentence, usually the last of the introduction, that states your position and signposts the reasons.
In this essay I will discuss examinations is an announcement, not a thesis.
Examinations are a very important topic takes no position.
Examinations are good and bad takes no position either.
Here is a thesis: examinations measure memory rather than understanding, and the fear they create does more damage to learning than the discipline they impose is worth.
